---
title: "Sample-level COI"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

This presents between-tool benchmarking of sample-level COI estimates. The simulated data are described in [Simulated datasets](../website_docs/data_simulated.qmd).

The tools benchmarked are [naive COI](../tutorials/PGEcore/naive_COI/background.Rmd), [MOIRE](../tutorials/moire/moire_background.Rmd), [TheREALMcCOIL](../tutorials/THEREALMcCOIL/RMCL_background.Rmd), [coiaf](../tutorials/coiaf/coiaf_background.Rmd), and [SNP-slice](../tutorials/SNP-slice/background.Rmd).

The reported summaries are Lin's concordance, mean absolute error, and mean bias. Bias is the estimate minus the simulated COI.

For each tool and each panel, tool comparisons are made with the parameter set with the highest Lin's CCC on samples whose true COI is 2 through 9.

Population mean COI is on a [separate page](coi_mean.qmd). Effective COI is on its [own page](ecoi.qmd).

```{r}
#| include: false
bench_src <- c("benchmark_data.R", file.path("benchmarking", "benchmark_data.R"))
source(bench_src[file.exists(bench_src)][1])
full_sample <- sample_coi_results("full")
mini_sample <- sample_coi_results("subselection")
```

## Full panel

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "COI estimates for all simulated samples with a true COI of 1 through 9. The line is equality, and the vertical axis stops at 15."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6.5
plot_sample_coi(full_sample)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Lin's concordance within each population for the best parameter set, on samples whose simulated COI is 2 through 9. The dotted line is at 0.95."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 4.5
plot_sample_ccc(full_sample)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  full_sample$metrics,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Lin's concordance, mean absolute error, and mean bias on samples whose simulated COI is 2 through 9. Monoclonal recall is the proportion of samples with simulated COI of 1 with an estimate < 1.5."
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Mean absolute error within each population at each simulated COI from 1 through 9. Populations with a mean absolute error of 6 or above are omitted."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
plot_sample_mae(full_sample)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Mean error within each population at each simulated COI from 1 through 9. Mean error is the estimate minus the simulated COI. The red line is zero. Populations with a mean absolute error of 6 or above are omitted."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
plot_sample_error(full_sample)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Share of samples with simulated COI 1 whose estimate is below 1.5."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.2
plot_monoclonal(full_sample)
```
